fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our 2013 fuel consumption, a hypothetical ten percent increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel would have increased fuel expense by approximately $38.5 million for the year ended December 31, 2013.

instrument_type_details.notes: Company states 'have not hedged fuel price risk in recent years'.

throughput.source_quote: Aircraft fuel expense increased only 1.9 percent to $385.6 million for 2013, up from $378.2 million in 2012 on a 1.4 percent increase in gallons consumed, from 118.8 million in 2012 to 120.5 million in 2013.
